svg.title: A nurse is teaching a client being discharged with a fiberglass arm cast. Which statements should the nurse include?
svg.desc: Nothing goes inside a cast, ever, because unseen skin tears become infections. A hot spot, new pain, drainage or odor all suggest infection and are reported. The cast does loosen as swelling resolves and may need replacing. An arm cast is elevated ABOVE heart level for the first 24 to 48 hours.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Cast Client Education
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching a client being
discharged with a fiberglass arm cast.
Which statements should the nurse include?
What fits here
Blow cool air from a hair dryer into the
cast if it itches · Cover the cast with a
plastic bag before showering · Report a
hot area, new pain, drainage or an odor ·
Expect the cast to…
Why it fits
Nothing goes inside a cast, ever, because
unseen skin tears become infections. A hot
spot, new pain, drainage or odor all
suggest infection and are reported. The
cast does loosen as swelling resolves and
may need replacing. An arm cast is
elevated ABOVE heart level for the first
24 to 48 hours.
